transitions.guard: Private root manifest and configuration verified
transitions.effect: Commit revision and ready event

transitions.guard: Owned partial state identified; no Run admitted
transitions.effect: Persist reason and cleanup identity

transitions.guard: Identity or journal cannot be reconciled
transitions.effect: Refuse conflicting starts and preserve evidence

transitions.guard: Local owner, fresh revision, verified owned root and profile, no nonterminal Run or unresolved effect
transitions.effect: Commit corrected config

transitions.guard: Revision/root unchanged; no nonterminal Run or transfer; ownership lock
transitions.effect: Block starts and journal quarantine intent

transitions.guard: Owned path verified; no use
transitions.effect: Journal exact owned cleanup

transitions.guard: Independent identity checks; no external grant included
transitions.effect: Commit tombstone and receipt

transitions.guard: Authenticated ownership and no pending destructive effect
transitions.effect: Commit reconciliation

transitions.guard: Explicit local Delete.resume_command_id; same owner epoch, original deletion journal/root identity, fresh revision and no managed use

transitions.guard: Confinement/resource prerequisites applied; supervised executor identity bound
transitions.effect: Record started time; payload_started may remain UNKNOWN

transitions.guard: No payload effect; outer owned group empty verified
transitions.effect: Record failure and release grant

transitions.guard: Actor authorized; owned boundary identity verified
transitions.effect: Persist stop intent and issue tested graceful signal

transitions.guard: Authoritative observation provenance; no terminal-text parsing
transitions.effect: Record raw exit; drain descendants and retain ownership

transitions.guard: Native outer boundary empty independently confirmed
transitions.effect: Persist final reason/exit and release grant

transitions.guard: Cannot authenticate ownership/completion
transitions.effect: Block conflicting cleanup; retain reservation and evidence

transitions.guard: Same boot/process creation/Run epoch and confinement; no Start replay
transitions.effect: Restore observations and require fresh terminal lease

transitions.guard: Verified ownership or host reboot proof
transitions.effect: Finish cleanup and final record

transitions.guard: payload_started=NOT_STARTED proved and owned outer boundary empty verified; no payload effect
transitions.effect: Persist definite failure provenance and release reservation; no Start replay

transitions.guard: Local owner or permitted remote narrowing
transitions.effect: Advance revision and reject future stale commands

transitions.guard: Trusted local time policy; finite grant
transitions.effect: Refuse future remote use; local runs continue

transitions.on: First import chunk or export snapshot copy begins
transitions.guard: Identity, expiry, source/destination no-use lock and quota valid
transitions.effect: Advance verified import staging or export-copy cursor; client reads do not alter transfer state

transitions.on: Commit import or finish verified export snapshot
transitions.guard: Exact length/hash and final root identity verified
transitions.effect: Persist COMPLETE; release source quiescence after export materialization; retain private export snapshot through ReadExport retries until CloseTransfer/expiry

transitions.guard: No uncertain publication effect
transitions.effect: Remove only known staging; retain reason

transitions.guard: Durable intent exists but native result absent
transitions.effect: Hold journal and staging identity

transitions.guard: Exact destination/source version matches original intent
transitions.effect: Return retained result identity; preserve export snapshot until CloseTransfer/expiry; never reapply import

transitions.guard: Owned staging and absence/rejection proven
transitions.effect: Safely release with original failure

transitions.guard: Outcome and aggregate revision durable
transitions.effect: Return same receipt for repeated ID

transitions.guard: Effect certainty known and recorded
transitions.effect: Return immutable failure

transitions.guard: Accepted effect might have happened
transitions.effect: Require GetOperation reconciliation; no new-ID retry

transitions.guard: Matches command and canonical payload
transitions.effect: Finalize once

transitions.guard: No conflicting effect; preserved audit
transitions.effect: Finalize once

transitions.guard: Correct boundary identity/value/metric verified
transitions.effect: Expose applied and observed values/times

transitions.guard: Requested policy not fully honored but safety preserved
transitions.effect: Explain degraded metric; reject unsafe admission

transitions.guard: Cannot establish requested safety
transitions.effect: Freeze increases; stop/refuse as policy requires

transitions.guard: Capability receipt identifies missing dimension
transitions.effect: Reject requirements needing this control

transitions.guard: New policy/qualification identity; no stale success reuse
